explanation: Carry the remaining target in a 64-bit value while descending the tree. Subtract each node before visiting its children, and accept only when the remainder is zero at a leaf. The public target stays int-valued, while wider intermediate arithmetic prevents a large path sum from wrapping into that target.
timeComplexity: O(n) worst-case time for n nodes.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion stack for tree height h.
attribution: Original Java implementation independently authored for EPI Practice from its displayed mathematical contract, using 64-bit intermediate arithmetic. No upstream reference implementation adapted. Public EPIJudge interface and test framework retained under the repository LICENSE.
